method: FFmpeg 7.1 decoded float32 at native rate/channels; peak=max absolute sample, mean=RMS dBFS. belowMinus60Fraction: duration when ALL channels below amplitude 0.001; additional duration-weighted 10ms RMS fraction provided. Flags: peak<=-40 or RMS<=-55 near-silent; >=80% sample-frame duration mostly silence; lead>=1s or >=250ms and >=25% duration long lead-in. Compressed priming included as decoded by FFmpeg.
